build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: checked FlightPose in flight-authority; existing snapshot interpolation arithmetic extracted to flight-net; old pilot and native local-flight host
ownership.mit: existing render-core rigid instances and shared render-wgpu terrain/mesh/device/queue; no new game logic transferred into MIT libraries
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt
ownership.readback_boundary: existing optional final captures and hardware test assertions read back; no runtime per-frame scene readback

authority_contract.initialization: existing FlightAuthority::new + initialize_world_site using the canonical COAST site and the TerrainStream source Arc<PlanetField>
authority_contract.solver: existing FlightAuthority::advance_with_budget; Navball attitude hold; unchanged fixed-step physics/control/resources/contact
authority_contract.native_local_presentation: latest completed local authority pose, no added interpolation, extrapolation or second integrator; body/light/mesh/tracking-orbit sample uses that completed SimTime
authority_contract.network_boundary: old embedded host retains its receive clock/inbox/delay and consumes extracted interpolation; native transport, prediction and reconciliation are not implemented
authority_contract.failure_boundary: invalid demand leaves authority/presentation unchanged; a physics error stops demand and retains the prior complete visual sample without authoritative rollback
authority_contract.preview_boundary: --vehicle-preview remains the frozen epoch north-pole constructor snapshot; --flight uses the later production COAST relocation
authority_contract.precision_boundary: local relative f64 preserved before rendering; absolute wire sources subtract sample-time ephemerides with a tested <1mm canonical error bound, not sub-ULP recovery; existing f32 visual-basis compatibility retained

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians; async material work and unlocked clocks do not establish a speedup or isolate adapter overhead

live_offscreen.boundary: full existing local physics demand + presentation/streaming/terrain/mesh/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and final readback; not isolated renderer cost or game FPS
live_offscreen.comparison_boundary: different camera/terrain cover from terrain-only and frozen-preview scenes; not equal-scene Bevy parity or an isolated physics/mesh overhead measurement; final sweep residency still converging

pose_microbenchmark.boundary: checked pose + render-axis/visual-basis conversion and timer/barriers; no physics, ephemeris, asset decode, streaming, GPU upload/render or waits

native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS; 12.4s simulation over 27.066s presentation interval does not establish 1x realtime simulation

legacy_bevy_smoke.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=pilot THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server executable absent: existing local fallback; ALSA/JACK diagnostics; different camera/time/game controls/effects, not audio/network validation or equal-scene parity

verification.new_regressions: checked pose finite/unit validation and relative precision, sample-time ephemeris subtraction, unchanged metadata/clamped shortest-path interpolation, complete old-pilot sample rejection, exact native-vs-direct-authority advancement and cadence invariance, retained source Arc/geometry, atomic body/light/mesh/camera publication and physics-error stop; actual advancing-model GPU rendering; flight argument validation and HUD/no-HUD native lifecycle
verification.review: local authority/presentation ownership, sample atomicity/precision, source reuse, body-space rotation, host clock boundaries, unchanged network receive policy and GPL/MIT separation

captures.meaning: normal terrain-only new-1 HUD regression frame
actual local authority at 10.5s, canonical COAST launch and tracking orbit camera
identical completed authority state, camera swept to 3.774rad; async terrain residency not fully converged
legacy unpaused local-fallback pilot, changed pose consumer with existing game camera/UI/effects; not equal-scene visual/performance parity

limitations: Local diagnostic flight host only: no native network/fleet receive loop, prediction/reconciliation, player flight commands, production flight camera/controller/UI or full client lifecycle replacement.
Materials remain base-color/Lambert, without native PBR normal/ORM/AO, shadows or atmosphere parity; inherited X15 scale calibration remains unchanged.
The old receive policy is extracted only at its arithmetic boundary; it is not a newly validated wire authority or interpolation queue.
No device-loss recovery, persistent conforming GPU bisector topology or FastRT acceleration structures are established by this slice.
